reviews.title: Janky
reviews.text: Does not open. Crashes immediately. Whoever invented this app should rethink an audio engineering career.

reviews.title: So I gave it one star
reviews.text: I was excited for the app, but when I opened it, there was nothing just no music

reviews.title: Do not download
reviews.text: Just do not download this you gotta pay $10. I was like what the heck I paid it and I refunded and they only last three days that’s just crazy bro just don’t download this app

reviews.title: No equalizer??
reviews.text: Maybe it’s only if you pay the weekly subscription, but it was just an app to import music, not, yknow, the title of the app, an “Equalizer”

reviews.title: You’ll still be charged even when you unsubscribe on time
reviews.text: I’m not slow, I know how to unsubscribe. Apple has stated that it doesn’t matter that I unsubscribed, they still will charge me. So I ordered a Samsung phone and leaving Apple. Not paying for something that never worked in the first place. Yall are horrible as hell taking people’s money and forcing people into contracts.

reviews.title: Poor customer care
reviews.text: I searched the entire description and saw no trace of a paid membership. But I never even got it all the way opened and there it was. So I hope this saves you a little time and from having to deal with morons.
